content.comment_body: Hello, I've recently acquired a [product_name] for personal projects and have completed a few tasks, including setting up an HMI interface. Now, I want to connect the PLC to external systems. Instead of reverse-engineering the IP protocol, I'm looking for guidance on what [company_name] software is required to expose PLC properties—such as input, output, and status flags—to a computer or web server, allowing me to view the PLC data on a webpage. I'm comfortable with server-side programming and integration, but I'm unsure about which [company_name] software to use. Any advice is appreciated. Thank you for your support.

Hi, There are a few options you can consider: One is to use an HMI panel from [company_name] that includes web-server functionality. You would need the corresponding configuration software, such as [product_name] Comfort Software, for setup. Alternatively, to access data on a PC, you can use an OPC server. Options include an OPC server from [company_name] or a free solution like Libnodave. Hope this helps.
Thanks, I'll look into those options. I appreciate the recommendations.

analysis.insight_summary: The main concern is finding an easy way to make [product_name] PLC data available to an external computer or web server, with existing [company_name] documentation offering limited clarity. Community suggestions include using HMI panels with built-in web-server features or adopting OPC-server solutions, but no definitive answer is provided regarding the optimal [company_name] software for this scenario.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects clear recommendations on which [company_name] software to use for convenient access and display of [product_name] PLC data from an external system.
